notes: '=>' is not a PEP 508 operator, so pip rejects the line while parsing requirements.txt, before contacting the index: 'ERROR: Invalid requirement: 'numpy=>2.4.4'' (newer pip versions add the requirements.txt line number and may add a 'Did you mean' hint). No versions list, no resolver output. (The original draft used 'numpy===~2.4.4', but '===' is PEP 440 arbitrary equality and accepts any string, so pip parses it and fails with 'No matching distribution found for numpy===~2.4.4', the same signature as inj-012.) Fails at 'Install dependencies'; no pytest summary.
